name: Puppet
author: Erin Carter
description: A hand-shadow bird performs in a lamp's soft-edged oval throw on a near-black wall — head tilting, beak opening in silent speech, feather-fingers splaying and folding. Crisp at its core and soft at its extremities, with a physical penumbra blur that sharpens and melts as it leans toward the light.

params.label: Gesture speed
params.effect: Tempo of the head tilts, beak movement, and feather phrases.

params.label: Splay
params.effect: How widely the feather-finger lobes fan at the peak of each phrase.

params.label: Throw size
params.effect: CSS-pixel width of the lit oval the puppet performs in.

params.label: Penumbra
params.effect: Strength of the graded blur from the figure's sharp core to its soft extremities.
